title: helenium aschersonianum
intro: Helenium aschersonianum, commonly known as a flowering plant in the daisy family, is native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce swelling and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Helenium aschersonianum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent, making it useful in wound healing and skin care. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
